english.note: Use 加大 as the all-purpose causative choice when increasing size, amount, force, or volume, including making a sound louder.
Use this when deliberately making an amount, level, force, or scale bigger rather than simply observing that it has increased.

examples.english: The company decided to swell its investment.

examples.traditional: 你可唔可以加大個音量？
